citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 3:20 pm on June 10,
2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by telephone with voicemail message left, text message, and email.
Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations.
Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
